import React from 'react' function BankProcessingSection({ application }) { const processing = application?.bank_processing || {} return (
{/* ------------------------------------------------- HEADER -------------------------------------------------- */}

Bank Processing

Bank and processing information

{/* ------------------------------------------------- PROCESSING DETAILS -------------------------------------------------- */}
{/* Bank */}

Bank

{processing.bank_name || '-'}

{/* Branch */}

Branch

{processing.branch_name || '-'}

{/* Banker */}

Banker

{processing.banker_name || '-'}

{/* Processing Status */}

Processing Status

{processing.status || '-'}

{/* Login Date */}

Login Date

{processing.login_date || '-'}

{/* Sanction Date */}

Sanction Date

{processing.sanction_date || '-'}

{/* Disbursement Date */}

Disbursement Date

{processing.disbursement_date || '-'}

{/* Disbursed Amount */}

Disbursed Amount

{processing.disbursed_amount ? `₹ ${Number( processing.disbursed_amount ).toLocaleString('en-IN')}` : '-'}

) } export default BankProcessingSection
